name: httap Local HTTP Interception
free_limit: MIT-licensed local HTTP/HTTPS interception and mocking tool with project-scoped proxy, terminal UI, CLI, TypeScript interceptors and MCP integration; no software usage quota or expiry stated.
watch_out: Runs on user-provided computer and network; no hosted proxy or cloud infrastructure included. HTTPS interception creates a local CA certificate and captures potentially sensitive request data; secure local storage and use only on authorized traffic. Some clients require proxy or certificate configuration.
